name: Beat Drummer
summary:
BEAT DRUMMER: Ultimate VR Drum Experience
Step into the world’s most intense drumming arena! Feel every beat, smash neon drums, and unleash your inner rockstar in hyper-realistic VR. Lots of head-banging tracks, dynamic environments, and multiplayer battles, this is rhythm gaming reborn.

🔥 KEY FEATURES

🥁 REALISTIC DRUMMING: Experience lifelike drum physics & haptic feedback – crafted for Meta Quest 3!

🌟 LOTS OF ROCK/EDM TRACKS: Master classics from Metallica to Skrillex, with 5 difficulties & 360° mod
